content:
The **Build-A-Bot Station** is a voice box character at Bot-Stop stations in Appalachia.

The Build-A-Bot Station voice was pre-installed at Bot-Stop locations and was used to monitor the creation of robots. They entice passersby to utilize the stations and give advice to users after unit production. Enclave Mr. Gutsies and Assaultrons emerge from near the station during the Enclave Event Enclave Activity: Bots on Parade.

| Interactions | | | 
| | This character is **involved in Quests** . | | 

The Build-A-Bot Station appears in *Fallout 76*.
